## Specific task description

Task instruction: Locate the gray and yellow rectangular microwave and open it using the left arm.

Success criteria: Use the left arm to open the oven door to at least 60% of its maximum opening range. Merely opening a narrow gap does not count.

## Execution tips

- The vertical handle on the right edge of the oven door, left of the two knobs, is a suitable grasp point. Hold its straight section away from the upper and lower joints to leave room for the pads and reduce the chance of hitting the door panel.
- Set the gripper opening to fit the handle width and surrounding clearance. Before closing, confirm that both fingers effectively enclose the handle from opposite sides, avoiding fingertips pressing only against its front face or the door panel.
- As the door moves, adjust gripper position and orientation to follow its actual rotation along the hinge arc. Avoid pulling rigidly in a straight line, which can cause slipping or jamming.
- During the left-arm approach, use the open area in front of the oven door to adjust the pose and leave room for the door to swing outward, avoiding the mouse and clutter near the microwave’s front left.
